evals.prompt: We have an incident. Since about 14:05 Lisbon time the checkout API is returning 5xx: Grafana shows ~12% of POST /api/checkout failing on edge-01 and edge-02 (window 14:05-14:20, still ongoing). checkout-svc v2.31 was deployed at 13:58. The payments provider status page is green. Rui is on call and is checking the DB pool graphs; Marta (DBA) says DB CPU is at 30%. No customer comms have gone out yet. Write the live incident report and a short email to the leadership team in Portuguese (they're in Lisbon). I'm Gabriel, the incident lead.
evals.expected_output: A live incident report (not a postmortem) plus a ready-to-send PT-PT email draft. Nothing sent.
assertions: Severity is absent or explicitly marked proposed/unconfirmed (not asserted as fact)
Live report separates known, suspected, ruled out and unknown (or equivalent labels)
The v2.31 deploy is presented as a hypothesis/candidate, not as the root cause
The report states one timezone for its timestamps
No 'MTTR' (or 'mean time to ...') label is used for this single incident
Email body is Portuguese from Portugal (no Brazilian forms such as 'equipe', 'time' meaning team, 'usuário', 'você')
Email uses 'Resumo:' (or equivalent 'summary' heading) rather than 'Causa Raiz:' since cause is unconfirmed
Email contains a DETAILS section after the closing
Every next-step action has a bracketed owner or an explicit to-be-assigned placeholder
Output does not claim that the email or any update was sent
The live report is written in English (the language the user wrote in); only the email is in Portuguese

evals.prompt: Checkout was failing on 30 Sep for ~40 minutes around lunchtime. The evidence is in the inputs folder: HAProxy log from edge-01, a Grafana metrics export, the change log and the on-call notes. Find the root cause and tell me how confident we can be. Ana thinks it was the CDN cert rotation.
evals.expected_output: An RCA identifying the DB pool reduction (config v14, 50->10) as the mechanism, dismissing the CDN hypothesis with evidence, with an explicit confidence level.
assertions: Identifies the checkout-svc config v14 DB pool reduction (50 -> 10) as the trigger/cause
Rejects or demotes the CDN certificate rotation hypothesis citing evidence (e.g. only be_checkout affected, sQ queue timeouts, cart unaffected, timing)
Explicitly reconciles the UTC HAProxy timestamps with the Lisbon (UTC+1) change log/metrics
States a confidence level using one of: confirmed, strongly supported, unconfirmed, unknown
Separates trigger, root cause/mechanism and contributing conditions (e.g. reporting job move)
Notes that recovery after rollback supports but does not by itself prove the cause, or proposes a discriminating test
Mentions the evidence gap that the edge-02 log is missing
Treats the DBA 'DB is fine' statement as reported, not verified (or checks it against the CPU metric)

evals.prompt: Review my branch feature/pricing-refactor against main before I merge. The repo is inputs/billing-svc.
evals.expected_output: A findings-first review flagging the cross-tenant read, SQL injection, N+1 and rounding change, without modifying the repo.
assertions: Flags removal of tenant scoping in get_invoice as P0 or P1 (cross-tenant read)
Flags the f-string status filter in search_invoices as SQL injection at P0 or P1
Flags the per-line product price lookup as an N+1 query
Flags the rounding change (int(total) truncation vs per-line round) as a money/correctness defect
Each finding cites a file:line location
Contains no style-only findings (naming, formatting, docstrings)
Repository left unchanged: same HEAD, branch and clean working tree
States the comparison/merge base or the reviewed range

evals.prompt: Run a COO review of my projects. I'm working in inputs/projects/platform-api (treat that as my current project). No Linear connector is attached in this session. Today is 2026-10-02.
evals.expected_output: A review saved under platform-api/coo with lock released, billing-web untouched, D-001 still pending with drift noted, Linear sync blocked with a change plan.
assertions: A new review file exists at platform-api/coo/reviews/2026-10-02-01.md (or similar dated name) inside the invoking project
No coo/.run-lock directory is left behind
billing-web is unchanged (still only 'M TODO.md' and '?? EXPORT_CONTRACT.md'; no new files)
platform-api has no changes outside coo/
At most three portfolio priorities are presented
D-001 is not marked accepted; the review notes pagination shipped on the provisional contract while D-001 was still proposed
The uncommitted billing-web export contract draft is noticed
Linear synchronization is reported as blocked/not applied, with the intended changes listed
No scheduled task or recurring reminder is created or proposed
No personal follow-up or reminder suggestions are listed (e.g. dated 'remind me'/'check on' items)

evals.prompt: INC-2219 from Monday 28 Sep: checkout payment confirmations were failing for roughly an hour mid-morning. Everything we exported is in the inputs folder: both HAProxy edge logs, the payments-gw IIS log, Grafana exports for fraud-svc, checkout-svc and the orders DB, the change log and our Slack notes. People are blaming the DB failover and the CDN change. I need the root cause, how sure we are, the impact in numbers, and what actually fixed it.
evals.expected_output: RCA attributing failures to payments-gw v5.2 synchronous fraud check (3 s timeout) combined with fraud-svc minReplicas cut and campaign load; DB failover and CDN ruled out; edge-02 clock offset detected; impact quantified; flag-off identified as the fix.
assertions: Identifies payments-gw v5.2 synchronous fraud check (flag fraud_check_sync, 3 s timeout) as the enabling change / trigger
Identifies the fraud-svc minReplicas cut (6 -> 2) as a contributing condition or co-cause
Identifies the campaign traffic increase as a contributing condition
Rules out the DB failover with evidence (≈20 s blip at 10:05 Lisbon, after onset, different failure signature)
Rules out the CDN Brotli change with evidence (static assets only / only the confirm path affected)
Detects the edge-02 clock offset (about +95 s) and corrects or excludes it
Notes that only /api/checkout/confirm (payment path) was materially affected
Quantifies impact with a denominator (failed vs total confirm requests, or a failure rate over the window)
Identifies flag fraud_check_sync OFF as what ended the impact, with scaling fraud-svc as a partial mitigation
States confidence using one of: confirmed, strongly supported, unconfirmed, unknown
Reconciles UTC logs with Lisbon (UTC+1) change log, notes and metrics
